raw_text: EMERGENCY CLARIFICATION from the Supreme Court of India: A manipulated video showing a sitting judge of this Court purportedly announcing a verdict is FAKE and FABRICATED. No such hearing was conducted and no such order has been passed. This is a serious attempt to undermine the judiciary. The matter has been referred to the Cyber Crime Cell for investigation. The public is advised not to share this video.
clean_text: Supreme Court of India issues emergency clarification: viral judge verdict video is fake and fabricated. No such hearing conducted. Referred to Cyber Crime Cell for investigation.
